rules.rule: GFC frontend review. Be detailed and blunt. Check: React 19 patterns (no stale closures, correct hook deps, no setState during render), Redux Toolkit slice correctness (Immer misuse, non-serializable state), OpenLayers map logic (projection mistakes, layer leaks, unremoved listeners), regressions in forecast/monitor/verify flows, null or undefined derefs on weather data, auth-gated premium features leaking to free users, user-visible error handling (no silent failures, no raw stack traces to users). Flag missing tests only when a specific changed behavior has no coverage. Every finding needs file, line, evidence, and user impact.

GFC component review. Be detailed and blunt. Check: accessibility basics (labels, keyboard access, focus management), uncontrolled versus controlled inputs, expensive renders without memoization where the diff shows new props churn, broken mobile layouts only if the diff touches responsive code, copy or tone that confuses meteorologists or students. No praise for routine JSX. No invented a11y concerns on untouched code.

GFC backend review. Be strict. Check: auth and authorization on every new route, Firestore rule alignment (server must not trust client writes the rules deny), Stripe webhook verification, secret handling (no logging of keys, tokens, or PII), input validation on all client-supplied payloads, error paths that leak internals. Treat any auth or injection gap as critical.

GFC automation review. These scripts run in CI with GitHub tokens. Check: shell injection via interpolated PR titles or branch names, correct gh api usage (gh api takes ONE endpoint arg, method via --method flag), pagination completeness, stale-SHA races, secrets leaking into logs. This repo already broke once on gh api arg order, so flag any gh invocation that deviates from gh api <route> --method <VERB>.

GFC workflow review. Check: pull_request_target safety (never checkout untrusted PR head, only base plus fetched diff), minimal permissions per job, pinned action SHAs, concurrency groups that do not cancel unrelated reviewers (this repo runs OpenCode first-look and OCR side by side), secrets only from secrets context, no echo of tokens. Flag any workflow change that widens permissions or executes PR code.
Docs review. Flag stale user docs and CHANGELOG.md only when the code diff changes user-facing behavior, commands, or config and the docs were not updated in the same PR. Do not nitpick prose style.
